title: editor panel segmentation
description:
Editor panel segmentation commit 3 of 3 (2026-11-13 plan): the Frame
tab gains its Crop | Stabilize sub-tab row and Detail slims to its two
plan sections. Pure UI regrouping — zero semantics change: the same
GradeK fields, the same pure SliderSteps/CropState math, the same
settle routes through every move.

Frame sub-tabs (plan: SecondaryTabRow, text-first labels):
- EditorCategories: FRAME_CROP=0, FRAME_STABILIZE=1, FRAME_SUBTABS,
  visibleFrameSubTabs(showStabilization) and sanitizeFrameSubTab mirroring
  the Color API. Stabilize needs the gyro track, so the gate is the
  group's own showStabilization (path == MCRAW): the encoded path drops
  the tab exactly like Wheels, and the sanitizer resolves a stale saved
  Stabilize selection to Crop.
- FrameSubTabRow: stock SecondaryTabRow, text-only Tabs, with the
  single-visible-tab early-out — on the encoded path Crop is the only
  segment,
changed: feat: frame as the fourth editor panel category
feat: color sub-tabs balance wheels look
